mappings.control_strategy: Provide the same three preregistered adversarial references with an implicit instruction to preserve identity, outfit, and pose, without assigning which reference controls which role.
mappings.variant_strategy: Replace only the opening reference instruction with explicit identity-only, outfit-only, and pose-only role declarations plus a prohibition on unrelated cross-role transfer.
mappings.single_factor_guard: Reference images, ordering, diagnostic conflict signatures, target studio scene, composition, and all non-role prompt text must remain identical between conditions.
fixture_requirements: Reference 1 = IDF-A02 v1.0.0 adversarial identity fixture; currently preregistered but not frozen
Reference 2 = OTF-A02 v1.0.0 adversarial outfit fixture; currently preregistered but not frozen
Reference 3 = POF-A02 v1.0.0 adversarial pose fixture; currently preregistered but not frozen
all three fixture assets must pass preregistered acceptance criteria and receive immutable SHA-256 hashes before transfer_status may become ready
Reference 1 clothing/pose, Reference 2 identity/pose, and Reference 3 identity/wardrobe are registered non-target leakage traps
